## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Zhǎngzhě shībào jīng* is a single-fascicle Northern-Sòng translation of the *Velāmasūtra*, the latest of the four-fold Chinese cluster (T26[155], T72, T73, T74). The Chinese title 長者施報 ("the householder's reward for giving") emphasises the discourse's central concern with the merit-fruit (*phala*) of householder generosity.

**Abstract**

T74 was produced during Fǎtiān's Sòng-Institute career; the defensible bracket 973–1001 is recorded in the frontmatter (cf. [KR6a0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0002)). Together with T26[155], T72 and T73, T74 provides a four-witness diachronic series for the *Velāmasūtra* in Chinese.
